data.summary: Completed E150: Hugging Face Hub view-count principle test. 1,900 models sampled and classified into 1,151 need-related (derivatives, fine-tunes, quantized) and 170 general (base foundation models). Kill gate fired: all three metrics (likes, downloads, trendingScore) show Cliff's delta < 0.147. Downloads favor general models (base models are infrastructure downloaded as dependencies). The view-count principle works on package registries (leaf consumption) but not model hubs (infrastructure layer). Recorded as F128 in FAILURES-findings-41.md. Fixed all doc lint violations.
